# Ad Sacrum

> > Ad Sacrum is a specialized physical therapy and rehabilitation clinic in Zagreb offering evidence-based treatments for musculoskeletal conditions, complemented by Physioverse Academy's professional education programs.

Ad Sacrum operates as a comprehensive rehabilitation clinic in Zagreb, Croatia, treating diverse conditions through physiotherapy and specialized techniques. The organization extends its impact through Physioverse Academy, which provides professional education and certification for rehabilitation specialists across multiple languages.

## Key Topics

- Physical therapy
- Rehabilitation services
- Pain management
- Dry needling
- Sports injury treatment
- Spine recovery
- Smart Flossing
- Cupping therapy
- Zagreb clinic
- Physioverse Academy
- Professional education
- Patient testimonials
- Treatment pricing
- Toni Marić
- Evidence-based rehabilitation
